t: Cost-effectiveness analysis of Hepatitis B vaccination strategies to prevent perinatal transmission in North Korea: Selective vaccination vs. universal vaccination
a: Background: To tackle the high prevalence of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in North Korea, it is essential that birth doses of HBV vaccines should be administered within 24 hours of birth.
